headline: Cathie Wood's ARK Invest Buys Robinhood Shares Following 23% Slump
summary: ARK Invest completed its largest purchase of Robinhood Markets in six months after the stock declined 3.3% on Wednesday. The drop widened HOOD's one-month decline to over 23%.
why: Robinhood operates a major US retail trading platform for equities, options, and cryptocurrencies. Portfolio adjustments by ARK Invest are widely monitored by investors as a barometer of sentiment in high-growth retail finance.

impacts.name: Robinhood Markets
impacts.why: Dip-buying by prominent fund manager ARK provides institutional capital support after a steep multi-week decline.
